newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba Specialty payout ratio to be 20 to 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ciba Specialty payout ratio to be 20 to 25 pct.

text.p: Ciba Specialty Chemicals, which is being spun off by Novartis AG, said it expected its dividend ratio to be between 20 and 25 percent.
"We will follow a flexible dividend policy and (have) a payout ratio of some 20 to 25 percent," Ciba Specialty Chemicals president Rolf Meyer said at a news conference.

He said Ciba Specialty has no plans for a dividend on 1996 results as it was still a part of Novartis AG at that time. Ciba will hold its first annual shareholders meeting in the spring of 1998 and at that time it will consider the dividend policy for 1997 results. -- Zurich Editorial +41 631 7340
